analysis.event_source: All known expert >=0 to <0 command switches, t>=2; common predictions t>=5. Require exact23 eligible events and parent event counts. Never infer physical phases or fabricate initial-prefix events.
analysis.frame_pair_fields: Both raw predicted gripper values, abs distance to0, sign and correctness, delta_g, actual expert target; current/history gripper squared errors and exact delta identity (h-c)*(h+c-2*y). Same-frame translation/rotation/7D errors are secondary and descriptive.
analysis.mse_accounting: Partition event rows by paired correctness. Each case contribution is sum(delta_squared_error)/all23 events for that seed, not conditional mean. Four contributions add to parent event MSE delta; harmed-repaired count equals parent error-count delta. Report actual target values, do not assume target=-1.
analysis.margin_rule: No near-zero cutoff, calibration, sign-threshold tuning or significance tests. Preserve every event and every changed case; means/medians/ranges only. Empty conditional stats null, empty sum/all23 contribution0.
analysis.pre_window: lags-4..-1: same-demo cached prediction only, preserve actual expert sign; null+reason if missing, never padding or cross-demo. Event windows can overlap and do not add independent evidence.
analysis.post_window: lag0..5 only while the original expert-open command continues; missing after command end is censored/changed-label, not0 or wrong. Every window has10 availability records.
analysis.full_post: Track the entire observed expert-open command segment from event through next nonnegative target or demo_end, no arbitrary truncation. Save696 paired frame records and per-segment current/history wrong runs, first correct, maintained correct tail, error reentry and boundary reason.
analysis.prefix_rule: For event-harmed cases report both initial consecutive additional-wrong frames(current correct/history wrong) and history total initial-wrong prefix. The former may end because current also becomes wrong; it is not necessarily history recovery. Symmetric rule for repaired cases.
analysis.nulls_and_timing: First-correct/tail-start missing stays null, with counts separately. Compare timing only if both observed; never call missing0. Reentry count has first-correct eligibility denominator. Segment end is not episode success/failure.
analysis.aggregation: Per seed and all3seed pooled fixed model/event descriptors; retain all69 events and696 full-post frame pairs. No cross-arm/source-task samples, outcome/seed selection or independent-episode claim.
analysis.prior_gate: Retain parent joint_query_cue=false and no-rollout decision regardless of decomposition; no automatic training/candidate acceptance.

execution.allowed_numeric_payloads: parent query targets/IDs plus six saved query predictions only; no features, support NPZ, HDF5 or checkpoint payloads
